gloss: riding double; riding two on one vehicle

definitions.gloss: riding two people on one vehicle; riding double
definitions.explanation: Two people riding together on a vehicle meant primarily for one, such as a bicycle or motorcycle. Compound of {二人|ふたり} (two people) + {乗|の}り (riding).

examples.japanese: {自転車|じてんしゃ}の{二人乗|ふたりの}りは{危|あぶ}ない。
examples.english: Riding double on a bicycle is dangerous.

examples.japanese: バイクで{二人乗|ふたりの}りをして{出|で}かけた。
examples.english: We went out riding double on the motorcycle.

examples.japanese: {原付|げんつき}での{二人乗|ふたりの}りは{法律|ほうりつ}で{禁止|きんし}されている。
examples.english: Riding double on a moped is prohibited by law.

notes:
Carrying a passenger on a vehicle designed mainly for one rider. Often appears in safety and traffic-rule contexts, since {自転車|じてんしゃ} (bicycle) double-riding and {原付|げんつき} (50cc moped) double-riding are illegal in Japan.

USAGE:
- {二人乗|ふたりの}りする・{二人乗|ふたりの}りをする: to ride double
- The pattern extends to other numbers: {三人乗|さんにんの}り (carrying three).

RELATED WORDS:
- {相乗|あいの}り: sharing a ride — two or more people sharing one taxi or car, splitting it
